The heart reveals a sophisticated core where Honey and Caramel melt into an earthy layer of Patchouli, creating a thick, syrupy texture. The dry-down reveals a majestic, balsamic foundation of Tolu Balsam and Tonka Beans. Anchored in Moss, it leaves a persistent, velvety trail that remains vibrant on the skin for over 12 hours.
